scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @tablia/api" "npm run dev -w @tablia/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @tablia/web && npm run build -w @tablia/api
scripts.deploy:aws: npm run build && npm run deploy -w @tablia/infra -- --require-approval never
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run synth
